text:
In June 2026 the median asking rent in Duisburg stood at 8.49 €/m², up 4.9 % year‑on‑year and 27.6 % over the past five years. The city ranks 34th of the 37 most expensive German markets, with the 25th‑percentile at 7.5 €/m² and the 75th‑percentile at 9.57 €/m².

The market remains balanced but tight: listings stay on the market for an average of 35 days and only 19 % are let within a week. Vacancy is low at 2.4 %, while rent‑burden for a two‑person household is 14.5 % on a 60 m² unit costing 509 € per month, reflecting a 45 % premium over existing rents (5.84 €/m²).

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 8.95 €/m² in the next 12 months, within a range of 8.71 – 9.08 €/m², implying a further 5.4 % rise.
